name: Mosses, liverworts and lichens
notes: The ground and bark layer. Sphagnum builds bogs and peat; feather and stair-step moss carpet the boreal and rainforest floor; cushion mosses on rock and walls; Racomitrium on lava; peat and haircap in the tundra; old man's beard hangs from the cloud forest; reindeer lichen feeds the caribou; map lichen paints the high rock. They read moisture and shade, not soil, and grow on wood, rock and ruins as well as ground.
